Although computer science is my main academic focus, many of my interests also involve visual and creative work, especially photography, aviation, and 3D design. I am taking this course because I want to build the skills necessary for future research. In particular, I hope to learn how to approach problems in a more systematic way: identifying a question, collecting and organizing evidence, testing possible explanations, and communicating results clearly. I also want to become more comfortable with tools and workflows that support reproducible research, so that my work can be understood, checked, and built upon by others. # If I Were a Package If I were a Python package, I would be `NumPy`. According to the [official NumPy documentation](https://numpy.org/doc/stable/), NumPy is a fundamental package for scientific computing in Python [@numpydocs]. 1. I identify with it because it provides a **foundation** for many different kinds of work: - data analysis - scientific computing - machine learning. 2. NumPy has also become an important foundation for scientific computing in the Python ecosystem [@harris2020array]. I also value building strong fundamentals and creating something that others can use as a foundation for their own work. ::: {.callout-note} ## Why NumPy?
